activationSource.record: FrameworkActivation { package, framework, state, admittedRelease, mode, provenance }
activationSource.granularity: per workspace package, then per file

detection.reads: the resolved installed version from the PM3 package snapshot

admission.otherwise: unsupported-version, with its reason; never coerced

switch.off: the whole Angular vertical does zero work for the package
switch.on: never admits a release this lock does not admit
switch.explicitOnWithoutManifest: on that names an admitted release activates with provenance explicit; auto leaves the package inactive

activationSource.capabilityBit: FWA1's admitted record sets the Angular ProjectCapabilitySnapshot bit; that bit gates the Angular LanguageRow::gated row and the external-template document-selector row
activationSource.abortCheck: FWA1's record is keyed by package, so a per-package @angular/core activation is expressible; the ANG0 abort clause does not apply

notActivationSources.role: selects which lint.angular packs run where FWA1 already resolves Angular active; it never turns the vertical on or off
client-side lexical colouring only; never activation and never product evidence

notActivationSources.source: angular.json, project.json or any workspace config file

htmlNeutrality.rule: A generic .html file stays neutral HTML until it is exactly associated with a component through a resolved templateUrl in a package where FWA1 resolves Angular active.
htmlNeutrality.association: ANGP findings consumed at ANG1M (ANG1M-AC3, ANG1M-AC6); an ambiguous owner returns NeedSelection
htmlNeutrality.neutralParser: CL10 neutral HTML (H08 verter_html_syntax) carries no Angular branch

hostPolicy.tsRegionAuthority: tsgo through the Verter LSP TypeProvider routes
hostPolicy.projection: ANG6 companion, project-bound through ProjectBinding/BoundProject and mapped back through ProviderPositionMapper; generated-only spans suppressed
hostPolicy.verterLsp: carrier-only enhancements; never computes a TS-region answer itself
hostPolicy.externalTemplates: a Verter LSP document-selector row gated by the FWA1 capability bit (ANG6, ANG6-AC4)
hostPolicy.inlineTemplates: LSPX11 Angular contributor seam (LSPX11-AC8), implemented by ANG5 using ANG1S CarrierStructureFeatures and ANG1M exact escape-aware authored maps; ordinary TS regions remain with tsgo (ANG5-AC5, ANG5-AC6)
hostPolicy.typescriptPlugin: @verter/typescript-plugin serves the companion only through its existing carrier-generic carrier-store path; no Angular-specific row (ANG6-AC6)
hostPolicy.stepDown: a Verter carrier-only answer is given only where LSPX11 owns(capability, position) resolves to Verter (ANG5R-AC5)
